violations.description: The complete approved Tauri command allowlist is maintained here as one long string and duplicated in crates/xtask/tests/generated_contract_gate_negative.rs:309-329. Adding or renaming a command requires synchronized edits in two differently formatted fixtures, so drift can make one gate stale or produce unrelated failures.
violations.suggestion: Define the approved command names once in a shared test fixture or helper and have both the release-surface assertion and xtask sandbox source generation consume that canonical list.

violations.description: seed_fixed_feed spans about 110 lines and constructs four related database projections plus a canonical hash in one setup helper. The inline SQL and repeated row-derived values make fixture changes difficult to review and couple unrelated projection details.
violations.suggestion: Split the seed manifest into focused builders for fact, content, provenance, and rule-evaluation rows, while keeping a small orchestration helper for dataset generation.

violations.description: This 97-line test combines successful four-dimensional filtering, multiple mismatch cases, cursor pagination, query-identity rejection, and cursor tampering without phase labels. Its name cannot identify which sub-scenario failed, and future edits must reason about several state mutations in one body.
violations.suggestion: Split filtering, pagination identity, and tamper rejection into focused tests sharing a small feed setup helper; if kept together, add explicit Given/When/Then phase comments around each scenario.

violations.description: The valid-page, projection-drift, and stale-cursor tests repeat the same opaque cursor construction, first-page response, and second-item fixture mutations. The repeated setup obscures the behavioral difference among the three pagination cases.
violations.suggestion: Introduce a local pagination scenario factory that returns the cursor, first page, and a customizable continuation page or error.

violations.description: The filter journey repeats the same invoke-call polling and findLast command lookup before and after reload. The duplicated callback makes the expected query payload harder to scan and invites inconsistent changes to the two checkpoints.
violations.suggestion: Extract a small latestIntelFeedArgs helper for the fixture and keep the two expected payload assertions visible in the test body.
violations.code_snippet: const calls = await demoApp.invokeCalls(); return calls.findLast((call) => call.command === "query_intel_feed_v1")?.args;

recommendations: Centralize the approved Tauri command allowlist used by release and xtask boundary tests.
Decompose the large fixed-feed database seeder into projection-focused builders.
Split the combined Core filter/cursor test into focused behavioral cases with shared setup.
Extract pagination fixture and latest-invoke lookup helpers while keeping assertions explicit in test bodies.
summary: Story 4.5 tests are generally well grouped and descriptively named, but have 5 maintainability violations (1 HIGH, 2 MEDIUM, 2 LOW), led by a duplicated cross-file command allowlist.
